# WorldMesh

> An open network of independently hosted 3D worlds. Worlds share one set of controls, link to each other through portals, and can let visitors see each other. Each world stays on its creator's own hosting.

## For AI coding agents

- [Connect a Three.js or React Three Fiber world to WorldMesh](https://worldmesh.net/connect.md): step-by-step instructions to follow in a creator's local project. No GitHub access or WorldMesh account needed; multiplayer uses the creator's own infrastructure, never WorldMesh's hosted relay.

## Vision and open protocol

- [About WorldMesh](https://worldmesh.net/about): world discovery today and the long-term city network vision.
- [Protocol](https://worldmesh.net/protocol): current interoperability building blocks and planned multi-city standards.
- [Build a city](https://worldmesh.net/build-a-city): independent operators and future capabilities.

## Reference

- [Compatibility standard](https://github.com/eliaswillnat/worldmesh/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): every option, event and method of the runtime.
- [Terms](https://worldmesh.net/terms)
- [Privacy](https://worldmesh.net/privacy)
